standardizationId.title: Standardization ID
standardizationId.description: Unique identifier of the standardization object.

data.title: Reviewed Payload
data.description:
An exact copy of the original standardization JSON object, except every value is replaced with a dictionary with the following values:
- **value**: The original value
- **review**:
   - **page**: The page number on which the value was found
   - **confidence**: The confidence score of the value extraction
   - **boundingBox**: The bounding box of the value on the page. These will be normalized coordinates 0..1 for the page size, in the format x1y1x2y2:
      - **x1**: The x-coordinate of the top left start of the bounding box
      - **y1**: The y-coordinate of the top left start of the bounding box
      - **x2**: The width of the bottom right of the bounding box
      - **y2**: The height of the bottom right of the bounding box

schemaId.title: Schema ID
schemaId.description: Unique identifier of the schema used for standardization.

schemaName.title: Schema Name
schemaName.description: Name of the schema used for standardization.

jobId.title: Job ID
jobId.description: Unique identifier of the job that created the standardization.

dataset.title: Dataset
dataset.description: Name of the dataset to which the document belongs

filename.title: Filename
filename.description: Name of the file that was standardized.

displayMode.title: Display Mode
displayMode.description: Display mode actually used during standardization.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Metadata associated with the document that originated this standardization. This just echoes any metadata you have previously posted on document creation.

fieldMetadata.title: Field Metadata
fieldMetadata.description: Per-field extraction metadata, keyed by dot-path into the extracted data (e.g. 'lineItems.3.amount'). Gives the page, the location on it, and how reliably that location could be determined.

transformedData.title: Transformed Data
transformedData.description: Output of the transformation chain applied to this standardization, if any. Unlike data, this need not conform to the schema.

transformationReceipt.title: Transformation Receipt
transformationReceipt.description: Hashes identifying the input, code, context and output of the applied transformation chain.

reviewId.title: Review ID
reviewId.description: Unique identifier of the review object.

reviewState.title: Review State
reviewState.description: State of the review. Can be 'unverified', 'verified' or 'rejected'. Unverified means the review is AI-generated and has not been reviewed by a human. Verified means the review has been reviewed by a human and approved. Rejected means the review has been reviewed by a human and marked as incorrect.

page.title: Page
page.description: 1-indexed page of the document this value was extracted from.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Confidence in the extracted value and its location on the page: 'high', 'medium' or 'low'.

boundingBoxes.title: Bounding Boxes
boundingBoxes.description: Where this value sits on the page, as [x1, y1, x2, y2] normalized to 0-1 of page width and height, with the origin at the top left.

FieldMetadata.title: FieldMetadata
FieldMetadata.description:
Public-facing per-field extraction metadata. Anything not declared here stays internal: the stored record
also carries how each box was located and why its confidence is what it is, which is our diagnostics rather
than something a caller should build on.
